name: STARBOX COFFEE
description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. A miniature cafe platformer with expressive Milo and Mira. Explore distinct cylindrical Espresso and Latte mazes, follow bean routes around the glass, brave optional star detours and outrun rising coffee. Solid wood, slippery ceramic, regenerating biscuits, large two-thumb controls and instant retries. Free play and Perfect Coffee cards.
